units.source_text: 夕雾嫌恶淡绿色官袍，所以平常不肯进宫，外面也很少出去。

en.t: Yugiri disliked the pale green official robe, so he usually refused to enter the palace and rarely went out elsewhere either.

units.source_text: 但今天是五节舞会之期，宫中特许穿便袍，颜色不必按照官位，他便进宫去了。

en.t: But today was the day of the Gosechi dance festival, and the court had specially permitted informal robes whose colors did not have to follow official rank, so he went to the palace.
He was still very young, with refined and handsome features.

units.source_text: 但样子比年龄老成，步态神气十足。

en.t: Yet he looked more mature than his age, and his way of walking was full of confidence.

units.source_text: 自皇上以下，公卿王侯无不特别爱怜他。

en.t: From the Emperor downward, nobles, ministers, and princes all cherished him with special affection.

units.source_text: 真乃世上少有的备受恩宠的人。

en.t: He was truly a rare person in the world, blessed with extraordinary favor.
